turns.question: How much less budget did the search campaign have left at the end of September 2026 than at the end of August 2026, using each month's last snapshot?
turns.answer: The search campaign (Search NL always-on, the only search-channel campaign) had a remaining budget of 4,305.00 EUR at its last August 2026 snapshot and 2,130.00 EUR at its last September 2026 snapshot (remaining budget, each month's last snapshot, 2026-08-01 to 2026-09-30); the semantic layer has no metric for the change itself, so the drop is the gap between those two figures. Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
